Getting here

Start here. Enter through Gate 3 or Gate 4, park, then walk or ride to the Registration & Check-In Marquee.

    Go to the venue

Look for the convocation arch

Every event gate uses this branded Convocation 2026 arch in GMU white, red and gold. When you see it, you are at the right entrance — follow the lit archway through.

Students enter the field through Entrance 2
Entrance 2 only

Follow your secretaries

Step by step

Your Convocation Journey

Follow this order from the moment you arrive. Phase 1 gets you checked in and lined up before 5:00 PM. Phase 2 is the ceremony itself.

1 Phase 1 · Getting In — finish before 5:00 PM
1

Park & arrive

Students and parents enter via Gate 3 or Gate 4 and park at P1–P5. From P3, P4 and P5 a buggy car brings you to the venue. Walk to the Registration & Check-In Marquee and enter through the Check-in Entrance (right side).

See the parking map →
2

Go to your registration counter

Report to your own college's registration counter inside the marquee to confirm attendance and collect anything handed out for the procession.

3

Refreshments & photographs

After registration, pick up a welcome drink and take a photograph at the photo booth.

4

Pass the security check

Next, walk through the metal-detector gate on the left-hand side of the marquee. Keep bags light; avoid bringing small children (as requested on the invitation).

5

Exit to the ground via Entrance 2

Leave through Exit to Ground, follow the red-carpet walkway past Thumbay Clinic, and enter the field through Entrance 2. Do not use Main Entrance 1 — it is not for students.

Entrance 2 only · Main Entrance 1 = no student entry
6

Enter the ground

You may take photographs on the field. Keep moving toward the assembly area so lines can form on time.

7

Form your procession line

Assemble at the Procession Gathering Point (to your left as you enter) and line up as directed by your College Secretaries.

Be in line and ready before 5:00 PM
5:00

Everyone checked in and in line at the Gathering Point by 5:00 PM

Latecomers may miss the procession. If you arrive after your line has formed, follow staff instructions quietly at the side.

2 Phase 2 · The Ceremony
8

Academic procession begins with music 5:15 PM

When the music starts, walk with your college line from the Gathering Point to the stage. Step up at the stage entrance on the right-hand side and take your assigned seat — both are marked on the Stage Seating plan.

9

Chief Guest arrives — standing ovation

Stand to receive His Highness the Chief Guest and the dignitaries on stage.

10

Award ceremony begins

Remain seated and attentive until your college and name are called.

11

Receive your certificate & photograph

When guided by your College Secretaries, form the line and walk to the podium. Receive your certificate and pose with it for the official photograph with the President and His Highness the Sheikh.

12

Return to your seat

Go back to your assigned seat promptly so the ceremony keeps to time.

13

Convocation Oath

Stand and take the oath together with your graduating class.

14

Address & speeches

Listen to the convocation address and remarks from the dignitaries.

15

Tossing of the cap

The celebratory cap toss — the moment you have earned.

16

Return procession

Follow your college line out in an orderly procession to close the ceremony.
